input.sql:
SELECT e.link_to_member, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone,
       COUNT(*) AS n_exp,
       ROUND(AVG(e.cost),2) AS avg_cost,
       MIN(e.cost) AS min_cost,
       MAX(e.cost) AS max_cost,
       SUM(e.cost) AS total_cost,

FROM expense e JOIN member m ON m.member_id = e.link_to_member
GROUP BY e.link_to_member, m.first_name, m.last_name, m.phone
ORDER BY e.link_to_member
